formulas.submissions_per_completed_page: F2's ledger rows (all four slices, unknown outcomes included) / completed answers of F2's listing-page log (a page completed twice counts twice)
formulas.remaining: submissions_per_run - F2's submissions (F2's completed pages are part of a full run's pages)

caveats: F2 read the rows in order and was stopped by the collector while it read row 15: its ratio of repeated, malformed and re-asked answers is that of rows 1 to 15, applied to every row.

The coverage file sums to more completed pages than the listing-page log holds: it counts a listing that is both a listing of its own and a partition of a parent once for each, and a listing of two CSV rows once per row. The estimate uses the log.
The historical page range is the census of 2026-11-02 (rows 7, 9, 11, 13 and 17 unmeasured then, as a range); ROWS_F2_VS_CENSUS.csv compares it with what F2 read.
USD at the reservation rate (a list price read 2026-11-03), not an invoice.
